feed.title: React/Next Js Developer for Dashboards
feed.description: We're looking for a frontend-focused developer to build and maintain an internal dashboard for our e-commerce business (naturida.de). This is for internal team use, so the focus is on clean, functional, and reliable — not public-facing marketing polish. The stack: - React / Next.js - Supabase (Postgres, auth, storage) - Deployed on Vercel What you'll be working on: - Building out dashboard views and data tables for internal reporting - Marketing Dashboards - Finance Tools Nice to have (a real plus): - Experience pulling and displaying GA4 (Google Analytics 4) data - Familiarity with the Shopify API / Shopify data, since our store data feeds into this dashboard

job.description:
We're looking for a frontend-focused developer to build and maintain an internal dashboard for our e-commerce business (naturida.de). This is for internal team use, so the focus is on clean, functional, and reliable — not public-facing marketing polish.

The stack:
- React / Next.js
- Supabase (Postgres, auth, storage)
- Deployed on Vercel

What you'll be working on:
- Building out dashboard views and data tables for internal reporting
- Marketing Dashboards
- Finance Tools

Nice to have (a real plus):
- Experience pulling and displaying GA4 (Google Analytics 4) data
- Familiarity with the Shopify API / Shopify data, since our store data feeds into this dashboard
